ziglang.org's index has no freebsd/ppc64 (powerpc64-freebsd) build for 0.16.0, the only patch in this major so far. powerpc64-freebsd was newly added at 0.15.1 and is present in both 0.15.1 and 0.15.2, so its absence in 0.16.0 looks like a dropped target rather than one not yet built -- worth re-checking once a 0.16.x patch release exists.
